title: Chart export bounds the output raster dimensions, not only the SVG byte size: oversized requests are refused with a typed 4xx and every PNG stays within the pixel budget

criteria.given: an SVG whose intrinsic width/height (no size field) exceeds the pixel budget (for example width=3000 height=10)
criteria.then: POST /rest/saiku/{user}/export/saiku/chart with type=png is refused with a typed 4xx before any raster is allocated, never a 200 with an image wider than the maximum

criteria.given: a size field plus an SVG with an extreme aspect ratio (width=1 height=100, size=32)
criteria.then: the export succeeds but the returned PNG is never taller than the maximum, instead of the old 32x3200

criteria.given: an SVG with percentage or missing dimensions (width=100% height=100% and a viewBox) and a size field
criteria.then: the export succeeds and the returned PNG is bounded by the pixel budget

criteria.given: an ordinary chart SVG (800x600, no size field)
criteria.then: the export is unchanged: a 200 PNG of exactly 800x600
